GeoWorlde
https://geoworldle.com › worldle-unlimited
Play Worldle Unlimited. Guess the country by their map outlines in this fun and endless practice game! You have six tries to get it right.
AI Overview
You can play the geography-guessing game without daily limits at WORLDLE UNLIMITED or The Worldle Unlimited. 
WORLDLE UNLIMITED
 +1
How to Play
View the shape: You see the silhouette or outline of a mystery country. 
WORLDLE UNLIMITED
 +1
Make a guess: Type and submit any country name. 
WORLDLE UNLIMITED
Read the clues: After each try, you receive two hints:
Distance: How many kilometers or miles away your guess is from the target country.
Direction: An arrow pointing toward the actual location of the mystery country. 
WORLDLE UNLIMITED
 +1
Solve in 6 tries: You have six total attempts to identify the country. 
WORLDLE UNLIMITED
Endless mode: Once a round finishes or whenever you refresh the page (press F5), a new country appears immediately so you can play again right away. 
WORLDLE UNLIMITED
